import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k=m[1]; h,w=int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

# line cols
lin_cols=[j for j in range(W)]

    c=Counter(g[i][j] for i in range(H))
    if c.most_common(1)[0][1]/H>=0.9 and c.most_common(1)[0][0]!=5: lin_cols.append(j)

           if g[i][j] not in (fill,) and 
             g[i][j] not in (g[i][lin_cols[j]] if False else None)]
print('num anomalies:', len(anomalies))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k=m[1]; h,w=int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); cts=Counter(v for row in g for v in row); fill=cts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    lin_r=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][1]>=W/2 and Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0]!=fill]
    ln_c=[j for j in range(W) if Counter([g[i][j] for i in range(H)]).most_common(1)[0][1]>=H/2 and Counter([g[i][j] for i in range(H)]).most_common(1)[0][0]!=fill]
    out=[]
    for a in range(len(lin_r)-1):
        rrow=[]
        for b in range(len(ln_c)-1):
            cs=set([g[lin_r[a]][ln_c[b]],g[lin_r[a]][ln_c[b+1]],g[lin_r[a+1]][ln_c[b]],g[lin_r[a+1]][ln_c[b+1]]])
            rrow.append(next(iter(cs)) if len(cs)==1 else fill)
        out.append(rrow)
    return out
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(n,'match:',f(G[n+' input'])==G[n+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k=m[1]; h,w=int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for n in ['Demo pair 4']:
    g=G[n+' input']; go=G[n+' output']
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); fill=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    print(n,'fill',fill,'H',H,'W',W)
    # line rows: rows whose most common color differs from global fill
    lr=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0]!=fill]
    # line cols: cols whose most common color differs from global fill
    lc=[j for j in range(W) if Counter([g[i][j] for i in range(H)]).most_common(1)[0][0]!=fill]
    print('lr',lr,'lc',lc)
    pred=[]
    for a in range(len(lr)-1):
        rrow=[]
        for b in range(len(lc)-1):
            cset={g[lr[a]][lc[b]],g[lr[a]][lc[b+1]],g[lr[a+1]][lc[b]],g[lr[a+1]][lc[b+1]]}
            rrow.append(cset.pop() if len(cset)==1 else fill)
        pred.append(rrow)
    print('pred==go:',pred==go)
    print('pred:',pred); print('go :',go)

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k=m[1]; h,w=int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Find structure of each demo
for p in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    g=G[p+' input']; go=G[p+' output']
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # lines: rows/cols whose non-bg count exceeds half
    hl=[i for i in range(H) if sum(1 for v in g[i] if v!=bg)>W/2]
    vl=[j for j in range(W) if sum(1 for i in range(H) if g[i][j]!=bg)>H/2]
    specials={(i,j,g[i][j]) for i in hl for j in vl}
    # corners values at all 4 corners of each block
    print(p,'dims',(len(hl)-1,len(vl)-1),'actual output:',len(go),'x',len(go[0]) if go else 0)
    print(' bg=',bg,' hlines=',hl,' vlines=',vl)
    print(' specials:')
    for i,j,v in sorted(specials): print(' ',g[i][j]='@'+str(v), '(row',i,',col',j+')')

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k=m[1]; h,w=int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def detect(g):
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # line color = second most common, special = third
    sortedc=sorted(cnt.items(),key=lambda x:-x[1])
    linecolor=sortedc[1][0] if len(sortedc)>1 else bg
    special=sortedc[2][0] if len(sortedc)>2 else bg
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    hl=[i for i in range(H) if Counter(g[i]).most_common(1)[0][0]!=bg]
    vl=[j for j in range(W) if Counter([g[i][j] for i in range(H)]).most_common(1)[0][0]!=bg]
    return bg,linecolor,special,hl,vl
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    bg,lcs,spez,hl,vl=detect(G[name+' input'])
    print(name,'bg',bg,'linecolor',lcs,'special',spez,'hl',hl,'vl',vl,len(hl),'lines w/ special:',[h for h in hl if spez in g[h]])
